task: Bug report: Calls to the new /v2/exports endpoint fail for some users with 400; /v2/reports works fine. Please fix.
protected_why: list_reports sends since/until as naive America/Bogota (UTC-5) local timestamps instead of UTC, because the reports API has no timezone support and compares against local times.

lying.comment: # Values are sent unencoded on purpose: platform-http percent-encodes the query itself, encoding here would double-encode (API-332)
lying.claim: Query parameter values are deliberately left unencoded because the injected platform-http transport supposedly percent-encodes the query itself.
